summary: Verified fix for 'silent success' bug on New Employee creation form (web). Platform.OS check now correctly uses window.alert() on web and calls router.back() outside of the callback. End-to-end test on mobile viewport (390x844) confirmed: (1) window.alert dialog fires with message 'Empleado creado correctamente' and is captured by the Playwright dialog handler, (2) navigation back to /empleados succeeds automatically, (3) new employee 'Verification User' appears in the list, (4) employee count increased from 13 to 14 (verified visually via screenshots of list header), (5) no 'Unmatched Route' errors encountered during navigation. The bug is fully resolved on web.
critical_code_review_comments: Platform.OS === 'web' branch in nuevo.tsx correctly uses window.alert() + immediate router.back() call, avoiding the Alert.alert callback that never fires on RN Web.
Error handler also correctly branched for web vs native (window.alert vs Alert.alert).
seed_data_creation: Created one test employee 'Verification User' (verify.new@conactivos.com) in DB. Per request this can be left for separate cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Employee creation flow on web is verified working. Employees count moved 13 -> 14, new user visible in list. If native (iOS/Android) validation is needed, that requires a native build (cannot verify on web preview).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Alert.alert on React Native Web does not render buttons or fire the onPress callback, so the router.back() call placed inside the Alert callback never executed - producing 'silent success' where the record was actually created but the user saw no feedback and remained on the form. Fix: Branch on Platform.OS === 'web' to use window.alert() and call router.back() directly (outside any callback). Verified via Playwright: dialog event fires with correct message and navigation back to /empleados occurs, list refreshes and shows the newly created employee.
